run_metadata.coverage_summary: The environment's global outbound-egress block is unchanged and was re-verified this run: a direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returns HTTP 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed' and WebFetch fails with DNS ENOTFOUND for every external host. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures, confirming a deliberate network-policy denial rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document on ANY portal could be opened, so EVERY recorded opportunity is headline-level only (all 15 counted in entries_pending_detail) with no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents/contacts extraction. WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was the only working tool; it is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals. Despite that, this run surfaced a strong batch of concrete, recently-published buyer-originated opportunities, concentrated on Buying for Victoria (which returned rich, dated rows): Victoria DTP GPSnet positioning-software EOI (DOT46088, opened 16 Oct, the freshest item this run), CFA Cann Valley Fire Station works (CFA-2025-0198), North East Water CCTV sewer inspection (CT10718), Goulburn-Murray Water Mystic Park pump station (ATN 3017), Victorian WorkCover occupational-rehabilitation services (FOL26 3030) and Mallee CMA hydrological investigations (RFT00000031); plus Tenders WA rows (North Metropolitan Health Service reverse-osmosis maintenance; Water Corporation engineering-design panel; WAPHA aged-care psychology RFQ1099-1101), buy.nsw rows (Destination NSW Vivid Sydney First Aid Services RFT-12634710057; New Shellharbour Hospital street-lighting relocation), a QLD Transport and Main Roads reseal (CN-27645) and an LGAT dispute-resolution-advisors register (Tasmania). Re-confirmed and refreshed two carried items now with better metadata: Ports Victoria Station Pier fender upgrade (T421509) and Victoria Police prescription safety eyewear (T5956, closing 09 Nov). Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked - SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woodside, Fortescue, EstimateOne and Brisbane City Council's Ariba portal exposed no publicly-visible Australian RFx (all login-gated, invitation-only, or closed); their portals are kept in discovered_sources and no corporate opportunities were fabricated. Source discovery: seven genuinely new buyer-originated sources/channels recorded - North East Water, Goulburn-Murray Water and Mallee CMA (all Victorian public bodies on Buying for Victoria), Bayside Council (VIC) and Sunshine Coast Council (QLD) on VendorPanel, the Local Government Association of Tasmania's TenderLink portal, and the Unimarket platform (which LGA SA says will replace VendorPanel for South Australian councils in 2026 - a material source-landscape change to track).
gaps: EGRESS POLICY BLOCK (global, unchanged): the environment network policy denies all outbound HTTPS to external hosts. Direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returns HTTP 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed' and WebFetch fails with DNS ENOTFOUND for every host tested. Proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures, confirming a policy denial, not a transient error. Not retried per proxy guidance.

No tender detail page, specification document or portal listing page could be opened on ANY source, so all 15 recorded opportunities are headline-level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and exact closing times could not be extracted from primary sources. Every opportunity is flagged UNVERIFIED pending an authenticated/unblocked detail pass.

WebSearch (the only working tool) is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, so Tier 1 portals could not be queried directly; recorded rows come from cached search snippets of the buyer portals (tenders.vic.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, buy.nsw) and may carry inconsistent or stale date metadata.

Tenders SA (tenders.sa.gov.au): no South Australian government tender closing in Nov 2026 could be surfaced this run - the 'Tenders SA' query collided heavily with South African results, and the live portal is unreachable (egress block). SA Tier 1 effectively deferred. Note: the old Procurement SA website is reported permanently closed as of 30 Sep 2026; tenders.sa.gov.au remains the live portal.

Tenders ACT and QTOL (NT): only aggregator snippets (australiantenders.com.au) with ambiguous date attribution were found (e.g. ACT TechnologyOne support ~16 Nov; NT Katherine firebreak ~13 Nov; NT Nolans Project gas-detection supply ~20 Nov). Not captured as confirmed tenders because the buyer portals are unreachable to confirm; recorded here as discovery signals only, to re-check when egress is restored.

WA items City of Albany single-axle truck (~20 Nov) and Cunderdin community mural design (~12 Nov) appeared only via the australiantenders.com.au aggregator with ambiguous date-to-project attribution; not captured as confirmed tenders (buyer portal unreachable). North Metropolitan Health Service and Water Corporation rows are retained as they map to Tenders WA directly.

Prior-run open items NOT re-checked this run (egress block; not re-verified so not re-listed to avoid implying fresh confirmation): CIS Tender 11 (WA, ~1.8 GW renewables, closing 22 Oct 2026) and ACT Aquatic Strategy consultancy (closing ~27 Oct 2026). Both were strongly corroborated in earlier runs and are likely still open/closing imminently - treat as active and prioritise when connectivity returns.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto (Buy Local EOI for Dampier EII marine works closed 13 Jul 2026), Woodside, Fortescue, Santos and EstimateOne exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via search; individual opportunities are registration-gated or invitation-only and were NOT captured as tenders (portals recorded in discovered_sources only). Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Universities, TAFEs and CSIRO: no university or CSIRO opportunity closing Nov 2026 surfaced (CSIRO routes >$400k via AusTender; its Industry PhD round closed 7 Aug 2026). Public-health districts beyond NMHS/WAPHA, most GBEs (energy/transport/ports beyond those listed) and a broader council sample were not reached and are deferred to future runs.
recommended_seed_additions: North East Water (VIC) - regional urban water corporation publishing works tenders (e.g. CCTV sewer inspection CT10718) via Buying for Victoria (tenders.vic.gov.au); monitor each run.
Goulburn-Murray Water (VIC) - rural water corporation publishing infrastructure tenders (e.g. Mystic Park pump station ATN 3017) via Buying for Victoria.
Mallee Catchment Management Authority (VIC) - publishes environmental/engineering services tenders (e.g. hydrological investigations RFT00000031) via Buying for Victoria.
Bayside Council (VIC) - advertises formal tenders (>$250k inc GST) via VendorPanel as its e-tendering portal.
Sunshine Coast Council (QLD) - releases public tenders through VendorPanel Marketplace.

Local Government Association of Tasmania (LGAT) - runs a buyer-originated tender portal on TenderLink (portal.tenderlink.com/lgat) with sector-wide registers (e.g. dispute-resolution advisors); a useful Tasmanian local-government channel.

Unimarket - platform to watch: LGA SA states South Australian councils will move from VendorPanel to Unimarket in 2026 (free for SA councils and subsidiaries). Track as the emerging SA local-government sourcing channel.

Maintain the weekly VendorPanel Public Tenders sweep as the single highest-yield local-government channel (now spanning Bayside, Sunshine Coast, Noosa, Forbes, Sutherland and the previously-logged NSW/VIC/QLD councils), and add a Unimarket check once SA councils migrate.
